title: Outcome contract with terminal-state-only semantics
operational_setting: A buyer pays only if a final measurable KPI reaches a threshold, without caring about the initial value or path taken.
trust_boundary: Provider is paid based on independently observed result.
initial_state: Initial KPI may be unknown or deliberately ignored.
intended_transition: Final KPI is at or above the contracted threshold.

attack.procedure: Define and settle the contract using only a target threshold and final observation, then test whether any economically relevant information is missing.

success_criteria_for_attack: If the contract remains complete, Baseline is not a universal requirement and should remain outside the ART kernel.
